alt: DUP councillor Kyle Moutray crouching on a Portadown footpath, spray-painting a blue-and-yellow stencil of a bicycle with a double-slash — a double-negative 'No Cycling' sign
story: DUP councillor Kyle Moutray spray-painted an unofficial 'No Cycling' stencil on a Portadown pavement on August 26, 2026, but added an extra slash that creates a double negative — effectively 'no prohibited cycling' — and chose blue/yellow Irish road sign colors, accidentally using the iconography of the Republic he opposes.
why_funny: The sign he painted to ban cycling technically legalises it, and the pro-British Unionist politician did it in the exact colours used on Irish road signs.
